messages:
yara: Quick RFC follow-up: where should immediate rejects live — edge proxy or admission? We need a short-term decision for next deploy.

ben: Edge for fast QoS (fail-fast). Admission keeps rich signals for scoring and longer-term penalties. Edge should only emit a tiny hint header.

cheng: Agreed. telemetry note: do NOT expose numeric cost. Use a three-state hint (green/amber/red). SDKs can choose backoff strategies.

yara: Proposed header: `x-rw-quota: amber` and optional `x-rw-hint: latency` for debugging. No numeric fields.

ben: Also want a mirrored async stream from edge -> abuse-service for scoring. Sampling should be tenant-adaptive: high-risk 100%, normal 0.2%, with automatic short burst capture on spikes.

cheng: For fallback routing, keep a deterministic sequence in config: same-model-smallbatch -> quantized-variant -> lite-model -> reject. That makes canary tests reproducible.

ops-bot: Canary deploy queued: proxy-edge v5 -> canary slice 1% at 05:10 UTC :rocket:

yara: Action owners: cheng proto/schema for header (v0.1), ben admission adapter + scorer, infra to provision mirror topic. We'll sync on dashboard 09:30. :thumbsup:
